children: Where HeavyMap came from: the UK atlas, the first Hamilton–Niagara attempt, and why we started again.
Four days of field logs, August 2026
— 2026-11-18 · 1 min · origins, hamilton, niagara, logs, prior-art
The first Hamilton–Niagara atlas kept a raw log, appended as work happened. Four days of it show how the habits behind HeavyMap formed.
Timeline: from a UK atlas to the Hamilton map
Five months, three attempts and one city on the map. The dates below come from repositories, logs and data releases.
In August 2026 we set out to map the physical industrial economy of Hamilton and the Niagara Peninsula. We built the foundations and stopped before drawing a single map.
What the UK atlas taught HeavyMap
We went through the UK atlas module by module and asked what each one would look like with North American public data. Some ideas carried over directly. Some had no equivalent at all.
Where it started: an industrial atlas of the UK
Before HeavyMap there was a small map for finding workshops, factories and productive land in Britain. It taught us what a map of industry has to do.
